card.name: Patient-instruction verbs before 'patient'
card.fires_on: Words in label instructions where the next word is likely 'patient', such as 'instructed', 'advise the', 'Instruct' or 'Refer'. Also fires on 'Physician' in Am Fam Physician citations.
